Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Glendale for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Glendale Glitters Kickoff Weekend) through December 24 (Snap a Pic with Ol' Saint Nick at Westgate), with the Hometown Christmas Parade, Holiday Lights Train Rides at Maricopa Live Steamers (November 27 to December 20) and the Glitz and Glitter Holiday Extravaganza (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
